additional_requirements: The binge eating and inappropriate compensatory behaviors both occur, on average, at least once a week for 3 months

S046.name: Body_Image_Weight_Shape_Disturbance
S046.description: Undue influence of body weight or shape on self-evaluation.

subtypes.Distorted Body Image: Perceiving one's body as much fatter than it actually is or perceiving specific parts as excessively large when looking in the mirror.
subtypes.Self-Worth Dependent on Weight: Judging whether one is a good or successful person solely based on weight or body shape.

S048.name: Compensatory_Behavior_Purging
S048.description: Recurrent inappropriate compensatory behaviors involving the expulsion of food or fluids to prevent weight gain.

subtypes.Self-Induced Vomiting: Intentionally inducing vomiting to remove ingested food.
subtypes.Misuse of Medications: Repetitively misusing laxatives, diuretics, or enemas for the purpose of weight control.

S049.name: Eating_Large_Amount
S049.description: Eating, in a discrete period of time, an amount of food that is definitely larger than what most individuals would eat in a similar period of time under similar circumstances.
examples: Eating more than 3-4 times the amount of a typical meal within 2 hours.
Continuously eating large amounts of high-calorie snacks in addition to main meals.
Eating enough to empty a significant portion of the refrigerator or pantry at once.
Eating clearly more food than others during the same period of time.

S050.name: Loss_of_Control
S050.description: A sense of lack of control over eating during the episode (e.g., a feeling that one cannot stop eating or control what or how much one is eating).
examples: A feeling that once I start eating, I cannot stop even if I want to.
Thinking 'I shouldn't eat any more' but mechanically continuing to eat.
A feeling of helplessness that I cannot decide for myself how much to eat.
Eating as if my body is being controlled by someone else.

info.persona: Jennifer Day blends seasoned retail savvy with a sociable, competitive spirit, navigating community life through gardening, bridge, and baking, all while meticulously balancing practical budgeting with occasional indulgent splurges, and they keep a playful skepticism for new trends.
info.professional_persona: Jennifer Day, a retail veteran with three decades of hands‑on experience, leverages sharp customer‑service instincts and data‑driven sales analysis to mentor staff and streamline store operations, all while balancing pragmatic curiosity and a competitive edge that fuels their drive for a part‑time manager role and future boutique.
info.cultural_background: Jennifer grew up in a small‑town, white, Midwestern family with German‑Scandinavian roots, a heritage common in Westby, Wisconsin. Her upbringing emphasized self‑reliance, modesty, and a strong sense of community, values that continue to shape her work ethic and social life. She celebrates local traditions such as the Norwegian Constitution Day parade and the town’s agricultural fair, while also participating in church activities that reflect her Lutheran background. This blend of practical Midwestern pragmatism and a curiosity about cultural heritage informs both her personal and professional outlook.
info.hobbies_and_interests: Jennifer is highly sociable and enjoys group activities. She is an active member of the town’s garden club, where she tends community plots and shares gardening tips. She competes in a local bridge league, relishing the strategic challenge. Her love for community shines through volunteering at the Westby Summer Festival and helping organize the Senior Center’s weekly bingo nights. She also participates in a walking club that explores local trails, attends a historical society meeting to research Wisconsin’s Midwestern heritage, and enjoys baking traditional pastries for church potlucks. Her curiosity leads her to take occasional workshops on digital photography and DIY home‑improvement projects.
info.sports_persona: Jennifer Day energizes their mornings with the Westby Walking Club, trekking local trails along the Chippewa River, cheering on the Green Bay Packers on Sundays, and joining the community softball league for occasional friendly competition, while also enjoying casual bingo evenings at the Senior Center as a low‑impact social sport, and they relish the camaraderie each activity brings.
info.arts_persona: Jennifer Day pursues creative expression through digital photography workshops, capturing sunrise over cornfields, while also enjoying folk classics from Bob Dylan, the piano works of George Winston, and the theatrical productions of the local community theater, all of which enrich their baking sessions for church potlucks, and they often share the photographs at community gatherings.
info.travel_persona: Jennifer Day prefers weekend getaways to the Wisconsin Dells for water‑park fun, a yearly retreat to a cabin on Lake Superior’s shoreline, and dreams of a future road trip along the Pacific Coast Highway to explore coastal art galleries and fresh seafood markets, and they plan each trip with a balance of adventure and careful budgeting.
info.culinary_persona: Jennifer Day delights in baking buttery croissants, raspberry streusel coffee cake, and traditional apple pie using locally sourced apples and farm‑fresh butter, while also experimenting with herb‑infused roasted vegetables from their garden and pairing meals with Wisconsin cheddar and craft beers, and they often bring a fresh batch to the church potluck as a sweet contribution.

info.persona: Bobby Fletcher is an introspective 18‑year‑old who blends a quiet love for nature, bluegrass, and data with a habit of forgetting deadlines and an unshakable curiosity about the world.
info.professional_persona: Bobby Fletcher, an aspiring environmental data analyst, combines modest Python scripting, Excel pivot‑table expertise, and field photography from Kentucky’s rolling hills to turn ecological observations into clear conservation reports, while their introverted, easy‑going nature makes them a calm problem‑solver who prefers flexible, quiet work settings.
info.cultural_background: Bobby grew up in a middle‑class family in Lexington, Kentucky, a region steeped in equestrian tradition, bluegrass music, and Southern hospitality. His upbringing blended the modest, community‑oriented values common in the American South with the digital fluency of his generation. He attended a public high school where he participated in environmental clubs and local volunteer clean‑up events. Family gatherings often featured Kentucky‑style cooking, stories about the state’s horse farms, and occasional trips to the Kentucky Derby. While his cultural roots are firmly Southern, he also embraces broader American youth culture—social media, streaming media, and a growing interest in sustainability—shaping a nuanced, open‑minded worldview.
info.hobbies_and_interests: When he has free time, Bobby immerses himself in activities that suit his introverted nature. He reads science‑fiction novels and non‑fiction books about ecology, spends evenings stargazing with a modest telescope, and hikes the rolling hills and forest trails around Lexington. He enjoys birdwatching, capturing sunrise landscapes through photography, and building small wooden items like shelves or picture frames. On quieter days he tinkers with Python to create simple games or utilities, listens to bluegrass and folk playlists, explores the history of Kentucky bourbon, and keeps a reflective journal.
info.sports_persona: Bobby Fletcher enjoys low‑key fitness by hiking with the Lexington Outdoor Adventure Club, cheering on the University of Kentucky Wildcats basketball team and following Louisville City FC soccer matches, while also savoring the excitement of the Kentucky Derby’s horse races, preferring solo trail runs over team sports.
info.arts_persona: Bobby Fletcher finds artistic solace in listening to bluegrass legends like Bill Monroe and Alison Krauss, snapping sunrise landscapes inspired by Ansel Adams, and diving into science‑fiction novels by Isaac Asimov, all of which quietly shape their reflective worldview.
info.travel_persona: Bobby Fletcher prefers quiet, nature‑focused travel, having camped in the Great Smoky Mountains, trekked the Red River Gorge, and dreaming of a solo backpacking adventure across Iceland’s volcanic landscapes, while budgeting constraints keep most getaways within the Appalachian region.
info.culinary_persona: Bobby Fletcher enjoys whipping up bourbon‑marinated chicken thighs, hearty biscuits with sausage gravy, and pickled okra, showing a decent kitchen skill set, yet their occasional impatience leads to overcooked steaks and a lingering habit of leaving the stove on too long.

info.persona: Dianne Tinsley is a pragmatic yet socially energized construction supervisor who channels a love for historic preservation into hands‑on projects, balances disciplined budgeting with spontaneous DIY splurges, and navigates life with a competitive edge tempered by a flexible, community‑first mindset.
